summary: Jawdah storefront flow: Store-scoped Catalog availability/book-ahead policy and personal website-request notification reads, with future request fields.
noAssistantImpact: Catalog Storefront settings use an authenticated form with fresh Catalog-management scope, revision and idempotency fences; they never change stock, publication or bookings. Website notifications reuse durable request alerts and authenticated Store scope; acknowledging them has no Order, payment or provider effect. Customer structured intent and payment verification remain canonical; no new model tool, financial authority or provider activation.

procedures.reason: Catalog management form; fresh business/Store/member scope.
Explicit Store-scoped settings save; CAS and canonical command receipt; no stock change.
Personal dashboard request notices filtered by current authorized Stores.
Personal notification acknowledgement only; no business-state mutation.

evidence.result: Existing non-production Jawdah QA CAS/concurrent-save, stable replay, mismatch/scope refusal and unchanged stock/Order facts pass; original settings restored.
Three tests/11 assertions pass for business calendar, invalid/past/bounded future dates and service timezone DST fold/gap refusal.
Owner authorized implementation/testing with no deployment; full UI/payment acceptance remains pending.
